source: RFC 9381 Section 5.4.5 (ECVRF_validate_key), the bad_pk list for edwards25519, both sign bits

expected_values.invalid_encoding: PublicKey::from_bytes returns VrfError::InvalidPublicKey (non-canonical: y >= p, or x = 0 with the sign bit set)

cases.description: y = 0: the two points of order 4 (x = +/- sqrt(-1)) [sign bit 0]
y = 0: the two points of order 4 (x = +/- sqrt(-1)) [sign bit 1]
y = 1: the identity (x = 0); the sign-bit variant is a non-canonical encoding [sign bit 0]
y = 1: the identity (x = 0); the sign-bit variant is a non-canonical encoding [sign bit 1]
y = bad_y2: two points of order 8 [sign bit 0]
y = bad_y2: two points of order 8 [sign bit 1]
y = p - bad_y2: two points of order 8 [sign bit 0]
y = p - bad_y2: two points of order 8 [sign bit 1]
y = p - 1: the point of order 2 (x = 0); the sign-bit variant is non-canonical [sign bit 0]
y = p - 1: the point of order 2 (x = 0); the sign-bit variant is non-canonical [sign bit 1]
y = p: non-canonical encoding of y = 0 (bad_pk[5]) [sign bit 0]
y = p: non-canonical encoding of y = 0 (bad_pk[5]) [sign bit 1]
y = p + 1: non-canonical encoding of the identity (bad_pk[6]) [sign bit 0]
y = p + 1: non-canonical encoding of the identity (bad_pk[6]) [sign bit 1]
